kind: primary-source-supported owned-window probe design, not execution proof

sources.facts: GW_HWNDNEXT follows the window below in native Z order. Traversal can race destroyed windows, so the probe bounds the walk and rejects cycles instead of inferring a pass.
Layered-window hit testing accounts for transparent areas; WS_EX_TRANSPARENT additionally permits pointer events to reach windows underneath.

probe_requirements: Actual Windows Qt backend and separate owned underlay process; no game or input manipulation.
Actual painted pixels at both query points, native layered/transparent/noactivate styles and unchanged foreground.
Actual underlay below the overlay in Z order before checking WindowFromPoint; an overlay behind the target cannot pass.
Retained launcher and real Qt runtime ancestry checked separately; cooperative close and actual exit retained.
